name: Support-Conditioned Texture Residual
scientific_question: DINO/CLIP deep patches are strong on semantics/structure but may be blind to fine periodic texture, scratches and high-frequency changes. Does a cheap, training-free spectral residual (Haar/DWT or Laplacian pyramid) over gray + color-opponent channels, calibrated on normal reference images, provide evidence that is (a) different from A1 errors and (b) informative where A1 is wrong? Phase R0 does NOT fuse; it only measures region information value.

protocol_r0_info_value.a1_maps: A1 fused d_min maps recomputed from cached features (identical to frozen A1, seed0 k1)
protocol_r0_info_value.candidate_regions: A1 error regions: (i) A1 false-negative candidates: GT-positive connected components where A1 max score in component is below A1's per-class 95th-percentile of normal-image scores; (ii) A1 high-score false-positive regions on normal test images
protocol_r0_info_value.str_map: 2-level Haar wavelet, gray + R-G + B-Y opponent channels, per-band local median/MAD calibrated on normal reference patches (same positions as A1), robust z-score, trimmed mean across bands -> residual map at A1 resolution (448)
protocol_r0_info_value.region_information_value: per candidate region, P90 of STR residual inside region vs A1's P90; region-level AP comparing 'STR residual as predictor of being an A1-error region' relative to 'A1 score as predictor'
protocol_r0_info_value.spatial_misalignment_control: STR map shifted by half object size must drop by >= +0.02 in the info-value metric
protocol_r0_info_value.no_fusion: R0 explicitly does not combine STR with A1 maps

gates.g1: region info-value AP of STR >= A1 region score AP + 0.05, and >= 4/6 categories positive
gates.g2: true spatial STR beats misaligned control by >= +0.02
gates.g3: STR extra runtime < 20% of A1 per image
gates.note: if only one texture class benefits, archive as per-category observation, not a unified algorithm

leakage: STR calibration from normal reference images only; no test GT in map construction
